name: golden-trophy-full
description: Golden Trophy rooms 0..9: every non-random encounter, far spawn clusters, the exit doors and the boss, native SM64 input only.
notes: Golden Trophy full route rooms 0..9 for an S-rank attempt (rank = combat score only; solo deathless). Room 0 steps are the live-verified golden-trophy-r0 steps.

Native SM64 input only. Every encounter is started by walking the follow participant into its original OverlapVolume; far spawn clusters are walked and fought; before each door the required trigger is re-walked; fights use auto (punch-punch-kick, jump kicks on raised flyers, knights from behind); rooms exit through use-door (B at the unlocked exit door, original portal path). goto y is the planned floor height (informational).

Boss: rotating boss variant 3 cape-only NORMAL armor at MELEE x0.01 -> jump kick 100 -> 1 per hit (punch 50 -> 0); boss steps flank to its back. Expect about 800 landed kicks; the four boss steps are bounded at 20 min each.
MarioQaImmortal is for unattended QA only: run the S-rank attempt with Run-MarioRoute.ps1 -NoQaImmortal (QA refill suppresses the death mapping).
Skipped by plan: breakable pots (17400), DeadIsland tunnel flanks (1800, over lava). Authored max without them 169050 vs S 150000.
